title: The Apothecary Diaries
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Maomao, a young apothecary raised in a pleasure district, is kidnapped and sold into service in the imperial palace's inner court of a fictional China-like empire. When her knowledge of medicine and poisons helps save the emperor's children, the eunuch official Jinshi enlists her to solve mysteries of poisonings and intrigue (to verify). This entry covers the Square Enix manga adaptation.
life_message: It holds up knowledge, curiosity and practical competence, used to protect people and uncover the truth.

content.note: Poisonings, murders and court intrigue investigated after the fact (AniList Crime, Tragedy tags); detail to verify.
Mystery tension and some tragic backstories.
Concubines, a brothel upbringing and slow-burn romantic tension; references to the pleasure district (to verify; MangaDex 'suggestive').

Maomao is 'infatuated with drugs of all kinds (medicine, aphrodisiac, poison)' and tests them on herself; adult and underage characters drink, sometimes to excess, and smoke (Common Sense Media, anime, 14+, 'a lot'; New Zealand Classification Office content notes). Poisonings drive many cases.
Tragedy and grief in some cases (to verify).
Self-testing of poisons is a recurring quirk (to verify).
